title: Bayanan sirri, NDPA 2023 da zabar tushen halal

say: Bayanan sirri, Dokar Kare bayanan Najeriya, da zabar tushen halal.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 1 na Sirri na Dijital da Kariyar Bayanai.
Kariyar bayanai ta shafi mutane ne, ba kwamfutoci ba.
Jerin abokan ciniki, rukunin WhatsApp, rajista na ɗalibai, takardar biyan kuɗi da kwalin takarda duk suna riƙe da bayanai game da mutane na gaske.

say: Kafin ka yanke shawarar wanda dole ne ya yi abin, ambaci ayyuka uku daidai. Batun bayanan shine mutumin da bayanan ke ciki, kamar abokin ciniki wanda ya ba da odar riga.

panel.heading: Mutane ukun da suka shiga hannu

cards.d: Mutumin da bayanan yake game da shi. Misali, abokin ciniki wanda ya ba da odar riguna daga tela.
Yana yanke shawarar dalilin da kuma yadda ake amfani da bayanai. Kasuwancin tela wanda ke adana ma'auni da lambobin waya.
Yana sarrafa bayanai don mai sarrafawa, akan umarnin sa. Ma'aikacin littafi ko aikace-aikacen girgije wanda tela ke amfani da shi.

say: Mai sarrafa bayanai yana yanke shawarar dalilin da kuma yadda ake amfani da bayanan. A nan, kasuwancin tela. Mai sarrafawa yana ɗaukar babban nauyi.

say: Hukumar NDPC na iya yanke tara. Matsakaicin shine mafi girma na 2% na babban kuɗin shiga na shekara, ko ƙayyadadden jimla. Mu yi aiki a cibiyar darasin Halima da ke Kaduna.

say: Ana amfani da izini sau da yawa lokacin da wani tushe ya dace da kyau, kuma galibi ana yin shi mara kyau. Ingantacciyar yarda a bayyane take, a cikin yare bayyananne, dabam da wasu sharuɗɗan, kuma mai yiwuwa. Janye ya zama mai sauƙi kamar bayarwa.

panel.heading: Shin wannan izinin yana aiki?

say: Shiru, rashin aiki ko akwatin da aka riga aka yi alama baya yarda. Idan kuma faɗin a'a zai kashe wa mutum sabis ɗin da yake buƙata, yarda ba kyauta bane da gaske, don haka nemi wani tushe.

say: Don tunawa. Bayanan sirri shine duk wani abu da zai iya gane mutum. Sunan matsayi uku da farko. Hukumar NDPC ce ke aiwatar da NDPA.
Zaɓi kuma rubuta tushen halal kafin tattarawa. Kuma adana bayanai akan sabobin a kasashen waje canja wuri ne, wanda kuma yana buƙatar halaltaccen yanayi kuma.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Bayanan sirri shine duk wani abu da zai iya gane mutum
Sunan batu, mai sarrafawa da mai sarrafawa da farko
NDPA 2023 na aiwatar da NDPC
Zaɓi kuma yi rikodin tushen halal kafin tattarawa
Bayanai akan sabobin a ƙasashen waje canja wuri ne

say: Yanzu zaɓi tsari na gaske kuma yi alama ga kowane filin azaman na sirri, mai hankali ko na sirri. Cika takardar aikin tushen halal mai layi biyar. Sai ka jera manhajojin da kungiya daya ke amfani da su sannan ka yiwa wadanda suke aika bayanai daga Najeriya.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
